The business is ready to grow, but proof is scattered across policies, systems, and people. For teams that need customer assurance, readiness evidence, or a faster path through diligence. Services on this path Talk to our team What creates urgency Your buyer isn't asking whether you're secure. They're asking whether you can prove it by Friday. An enterprise deal or renewal is blocked by assurance requirements. A customer, insurer, or investor is asking for evidence you cannot assemble quickly. AI adoption is creating new customer questions about ownership and control. 61% were required to hold a certification to win or renew a contract. Secureframe, 2026 Cybersecurity & Compliance Benchmark The gap to close The gap is between having good intentions and being able to show repeatable evidence when the buyer asks. 68% of companies have one or fewer full-time security people, while 93% call security a top priority. Secureframe, 2026 Cybersecurity & Compliance Benchmark Services on this path Risk assessment and risk management Initial Risk Assessment · Periodic Controls Gap Assessment · Cyber-Risk Advisory Information security program and governance Written IS Policies & Standards · CISO Support · RFP Response Services · Security Terms & Conditions Contract Reviews Privacy management and data protection Privacy Program Maturity & Risk Assessment · ISO 27701 PIMS Readiness & Implementation · AI Governance & Privacy Advisory ISMS, SSPP, and statement of applicability ISMS Scope & SoA Development · System Security & Privacy Plan (SSPP) Development Proof on record No formal security program, then SOC 2 Type I with zero findings and multi-entity SOC 2 Type II across a software portfolio. Transit Technologies engagement, published customer story How it runs SNAPSHOT A Snapshot scoped to the actual obligation, so you know what the contract requires and what it does not. BUILD A readiness program with continuous evidence on AiVRIC. OPERATE A managed program with questionnaire ownership and auditor management, so the engineering team goes back to shipping. Important risk and technology decisions are being made company by company without a shared operating picture. For ownership and operating teams that need shared visibility, leverage, and governance across multiple companies. Services on this path Talk to our team What creates urgency Your bigger competitors run cyber diligence on 81% of deals. You run it on 29%. A new platform acquisition or portfolio review needs a common view. Board, lender, or investor reporting is inconsistent across holdings. The portfolio needs more control without adding a full internal team. Sponsors above $25B AUM include cybersecurity in transaction diligence 81% of the time. Below $25B, only 29% do. Kroll, Private Equity Cybersecurity, February 2026 The gap to close The gap is between local activity and portfolio-level oversight that can guide investment, sequencing, and accountability. 26% of firms have seen a reduced valuation or exit price after a cyber finding. The organization cannot afford to discover ownership or evidence gaps during an examination or incident. For regulated and risk-heavy operators that need clear ownership, resilience, response, and evidence that survives scrutiny. Services on this path Talk to our team What creates urgency Your controls passed in December. The question is what they were doing in March. An examiner request, audit finding, or remediation deadline is active. An incident or continuity concern exposes a readiness gap. Regulatory, privacy, or AI adoption pressure is crossing operational boundaries. 72% still rely on periodic assessments; only 28% monitor continuously. RegScale, 2026 State of Continuous Controls Monitoring The gap to close The gap is between documented plans and an operating model that stays ready when conditions change. 86.8% of small businesses have deployed MFA, but only 51.1% require it across all key accounts.
